entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Sis!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You wanna just get this over with right[n]now, huh?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: That makes this easy.[n]Bring it on.

entries.speaker: Shadow Sae
entries.en: Do not speak to me as though you are[n]my equal.

entries.speaker: Shadow Sae
entries.en: I am the manager of this casino, as well as[n]its number-one player.

entries.speaker: Shadow Sae
entries.en: At the moment, you lack the qualifications[n]to fight me.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It would seem she looks down on us.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: And what if we would like to battle you,[n]no matter what?

entries.speaker: Shadow Sae
entries.en: I had to win time and time again in order[n]to reach my number-one rank.

entries.speaker: Shadow Sae
entries.en: If you want to face me, you must[n]continue to win as well.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Continue to win?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: It must have to do with the fact that[n]this place is a casino.

entries.speaker: Shadow Sae
entries.en: Correct.

entries.speaker: Shadow Sae
entries.en: Do you have the confidence to win?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: We might just pull the rug out from[n]underneath you if you aren't careful.

entries.speaker: Shadow Sae
entries.en: I don't expect much from you... but I'll be[n]waiting.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: This is different from our prior opponents.[n]She'd rather scheme than defeat us with[n]brute force...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: It's going up...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I wasn't expecting to come all the way to[n]a Palace only to end up gambling...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I've never done anything like this...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: What about you guys?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Looks like this is going to take longer[n]than expected.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We don't got time to waste!

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: No need to worry. Leave this to me.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: You know how to do this?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I'm well-informed on what it takes to win.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: In any case, we need to hurry and change[n]her heart.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: If she acts recklessly, both her chances of[n]promotion and reputation as a prosecutor[n]will drop greatly.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Sae-san didn't use to be like this, did she?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: My sister must have lost her sense of[n]justice because her desires became[n]distorted...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Do you think there was a particular event[n]that triggered her Palace's creation?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...I believe it's related to my father's[n]death.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: My sister took on all the responsibilities[n]of dealing with it herself.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Trying to earn a living wage, gain a[n]promotion in a male society, and[n]uphold justice at the same time...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Those things may have weighed her[n]down and led to the distortion within[n]her heart.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: ...My apologies, but we don't have time[n]to be sentimental.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: The longer we wait, the more people will[n]learn about us. The investigation will[n]advance as well.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Hence, we must infiltrate this Palace as[n]quickly as possible.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: She did challenge us to reach her,[n]after all.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Niijima's Treasure must be at her[n]managerial base of operations.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Either way, we have to get there!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: She said that the Treasure's on the[n]manager's floor, so it's probably true.
